description: Use for recent change: how many points the Score moved over 1, 7, 30 and 90 days, and how many days it has held its current classification. Choose it to see whether the Score is rising or falling; for the values themselves use get_score_history, for averages and distributions get_score_statistics, for past classification periods get_classification_history. Free through the Delayed date (the free cut-off, three months before the latest published day). live = true reaches the latest published day and costs $0.25 in bitcoin over Lightning, one payment per answer, no subscription: the first call returns an invoice instead of data (steps under payment). Changes describe the past, not what comes next.

live.description: true: data through the latest published day, paid ($0.25). Omit or false: the free answer, through the Delayed date.

payment.description: Omit on the first call: a paid request then returns a Lightning invoice (valid 10 minutes) and a macaroon instead of data. Pay it, then repeat the call with the same other arguments and payment = "<macaroon>:<preimage>" (the preimage your wallet shows once paid) within 24 hours. A used, expired or mismatched proof is refused with the reason; call again without payment for a new invoice.
